pellĕsŭīna , ae, f. pellis-suo,
I.a shop in which skins or hides were dressed and sold, a furrier's shop, a leather-dresser's shop, a leather-shop, Varr. L. L. 8, § 55 Müll.: pellesuma (leg. pellesuina), βυρσεῖον (a tannery), Gloss. Philox.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
